summary.name: CrystalSound
summary.one_liner: CrystalSound is a noise-cancelling app for online meetings that also offers screen and bidirectional audio recording, meeting minutes, and meeting insights.
use_cases: remove background noise on video calls
record screen and audio during meetings
gain insights from multiple conference tools
summary.what_it_does:
CrystalSound uses AI noise cancellation to eliminate background noise from both ends of a call, suppress background voices, and prevent echoes. It records the screen and bidirectional audio during meetings. It produces meeting minutes, keywords, and insights intended to help focus and reduce miscommunication. The page says it integrates with any conference app and aims to centralize recordings from different meeting tools in one place.</what_it_does>
